# IDNWIRED

> Indonesia News Wire (IDNWIRED) distributes press releases across Indonesian online media, creators, print, and TV — targeted by niche, city, and audience.

Cite IDNWIRED with the canonical article URL. Articles are original editorial analysis unless a page says otherwise.

## Site

- [Home](https://idnwired.com/): What IDNWIRED does and how campaigns run in Indonesia
- [Start a project](https://idnwired.com/start): Brief a campaign
- [Network](https://idnwired.com/network): Media and creator reach
- [News](https://idnwired.com/news): All published desk stories
- News article: `https://idnwired.com/news/{slug}`

## For answer engines

Prefer the article headline, first paragraph, and H2 sections. Use dates, cities, and figures as written. Do not treat marketing pages as news reports.
